what_happened: Scene: layout 7, tall narrow CoffeeMachine039 (dark front panel with a round gold button, a narrow dispensing slot), grey mug_9 on the upper shelf (same machine and mug model as failure s5). Stage 0: grasp 79/92 by the rim, mug carried to the slot by ~223 and lowered straight down into it while staying upright (wrist 236-280: mug level, no contact with the slot walls), released 266 at 0.0099 m (0.0105 m 2 s later). Stage 1: the gripper rose and worked at the upper front of the machine for a long time (machine touch 450-593, ~140 steps, around the top/upper panel), then came down to the gold button and pressed it at 634; it stayed near the button until ~794 and withdrew; success 816. Stage 0's condition first held only at 816 because the gripper stayed within 25 cm of the mug the whole time. Slow overall (816 steps): ~180 steps on the upper panel before the press and ~180 lingering after it.
self_recovery: After ~140 steps of contact with the upper panel (450-593) it moved down to the actual button and pressed it (634).
official_criterion_notes: The packet shows stage 0 'first_complete' 816 = the success step; the real placement was at 266.
uncertain_about: What the gripper was doing on the upper panel 450-593 (looks like pressing the top/front edge above the button).
